title: Online Pay: making payment choice feel clear
focus: Customers struggled to tell three financing options apart at checkout. Session data showed drop-off at payment selection.
alt: Mattress Firm Online Pay checkout project cover from Nansi’s portfolio
sections: Customers struggled to tell three financing options apart at checkout. Session data showed drop-off at payment selection.
I led research and UX. Fourteen interviews helped us focus on explaining financing options in plain language and showing details when shoppers needed them.
The published case study reports 17% higher checkout conversion and 3× financing adoption.
